recognize_zh: 表皮棘層內有一個由數顆深染、核不規則的淋巴球聚集而成、周圍有空隙的小團（Pautrier 微膿瘍），基底層附近也可見帶透明空暈（halo）的淋巴球，而周圍角質細胞海綿化輕微，符合蕈狀肉芽腫。
features: Intraepidermal collection of atypical lymphocytes within a clear space in the spinous layer (Pautrier microabscess)
Lymphocytes with hyperchromatic, irregular to cerebriform nuclei, larger than dermal lymphocytes
Haloed lymphocytes (clear perinuclear space) in the basal and lower spinous layers
Papillary dermis with mild fibrosis and scattered lymphocytes with irregular nuclei
describe_en: Skin biopsy shows a mildly acanthotic epidermis containing an intraepidermal cluster of atypical lymphocytes with hyperchromatic, convoluted nuclei lying within a clear space, consistent with a Pautrier microabscess. Additional single haloed lymphocytes are present in the basal and lower spinous layers, and epidermotropism is disproportionate to the minimal spongiosis. The papillary dermis shows wiry collagen with scattered lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with mycosis fungoides, patch/plaque stage, in the appropriate clinical and immunophenotypic context.

ddx.dx: Spongiotic dermatitis with Langerhans cell microvesicles
ddx.vs: Langerhans cell microgranulomas contain pale reniform-nucleated histiocytic cells in a spongiotic vesicle, rather than hyperchromatic cerebriform lymphocytes without spongiosis.
Lichenoid reactions show basal vacuolar damage, Civatte bodies and a band-like infiltrate of non-atypical lymphocytes.
ATLL can show Pautrier-like microabscesses; separation needs HTLV-1 serology, CD25 expression and peripheral blood flower cells.

ddx.dx: Pagetoid melanoma in situ or Paget disease
ddx.vs: Pagetoid tumor cells have abundant pale cytoplasm and are SOX10 or CK7 positive, not CD3-positive lymphocytes.
